title: 2023's disaster count vs the all-time yearly average

source.name: Billion-Dollar Weather and Climate Disasters
source.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)

notes: 2023 had 28 billion-dollar disasters, the most in a single year since NOAA's records began in 1980 — more than 3x the all-time annual average of 8.5.
